description.narrative: "The purpose of this proposal is to strengthen rhino protection by improving law enforcement capabilities, eliciting cooperation from communities and preparing an action plan for long term protection. ..This will be done by: ..1) Establishing and operating three Rhino Protection Units for at least 15 days per month to detect illegal activities, removing encroachment/poaching camps and snares, helping law enforcement agencies deal with offences, recording rhino signs observed, and using data to analyze population trends; ..2) Mobilizing community support in the fringe villages of the rhino areas by holding awareness camps to elicit support for conservation of the rhinos and other mega fauna and holding separate trainings and workshops for the village heads and public representatives to mobilize institutional support; ..3) Assessing alternative livelihood mechanisms for reducing human pressure on wildlife and assessing human-wildlife conflicts in the villages surrounding the park, assessing the quantity of anthropogenic pressures on the park, assessing the impact of human pressure through Participatory Rural Appraisal (PRA) exercises, preparing livelihood activities for reducing human pressure and submitting the plans to the local government for use in sustainable village development;..4) Improving the management effectiveness of Gunung Leuser National Park by providing additional training on patrolling, crime detection, and law enforcement, identification of the signs of wild animals, and the use of GPS and GIS techniques; and..5) Developing long term conservation action plans needed to ensure the survival of fragmented rhinoceros populations. Project data will be used to develop site specific actions needed to improve protection and management. Forest and conservation experts will be engaged to analyze the RPU field data, community dependency, and PRA data for village level conservation and to develop site specific conservation plans.
